texts: With a 19-mm annulus in a 100-kg 18-year-old, the most reasonable step is a posterior annular enlarging procedure and re-sizing: B.
A 19-mm prosthesis in a large adult would cause severe patient-prosthesis mismatch, with a high gradient and poor long-term results.

A posterior enlargement (Nicks or Manouguian) widens the annulus by one or two valve sizes; a Konno operation, opening the septum and right ventricular outflow, is kept for more severe tunnel or annular hypoplasia.
In the picture, the collar is widened at the back so full-size dentures fit, and the child-size dentures are put away.
Memory hook: a giant needs a wider collar, not child-size dentures.
